rootCause: Actual live page contained valid AI fields and was waiting in cost review above the form. Launch was disabled while the stale suggestion note remained visible. There was no requirement to edit a valid AI suggestion. Wallet/RPC/review waits were unbounded and startup could admit duplicate attempts.
fixes: Shared AI/manual metadata validation before wallet connection
AI updates all controlled fields and does not require a dirty/edit event
Cost review next to Launch with automatic scroll/focus
Bounded wallet/RPC/review waits, cancellation and late-result isolation
Bounded lowercase-gpay search with progress and cancellation
Preserve exact Devnet transaction validation and simulation
Wipe temporary mint secret on success and failure
